messages:
maria_docs: Quick doc bug: /v1/transform API ref uses `k_top` in the sample request but runtime and SDK expect `top_k`. Also the curl example incorrectly posts a JSON array instead of an object — causes SDK snippet confusion. PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321 — needs small changes: param rename in examples, update python/js SDK snippets, and regenerate the examples in the OpenAPI file.

alex_tech: Nice catch — I saw the failing doc CI for that. @maria_docs can you paste the minimal failing curl snippet? I can patch the example.

maria_docs: ```bash
curl -s -X POST "https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/transform" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '["Create a summary", {"k_top":5, "temperature":0.7}]'
# => 400: expected object, got array
```

sam_platform: I can add a small transformation in docs build to normalize the example, but we should fix the source examples. @alex_tech if you can confirm server accepts `top_k`, we can change docs and add a short migration note.

jordan_api: Server accepts both `top_k` and `k_top` in the body for backward compat, but SDK was recently updated to send `top_k`. So the docs should prefer top_k and note legacy alias. I'll leave a comment on PR.

maria_docs: Great. Plan: 1) Update examples in openapi.yaml to use `top_k` (docs PR 4321), 2) Update Python/JS snippets in examples dir, 3) Add migration blurb under /v1/transform section. Who can review?

alex_tech: :thumbsup: I can review the examples and send a tiny follow-up to fix the SDK snippet content. ETA today.

sam_platform: I'll run the docs preview after the PR and check the generated swagger HTML. Ping me when merged.

docs-bot: CI: docs-lint failed — JSON examples/transform.json: schema mismatch at body. (link: https://ci.redwood.dev/4567)

maria_docs: Thanks bot. I'll push a commit that replaces the array with an object and swaps `k_top` -> `top_k`. Also updating the JS snippet to use `top_k` in examples/js/transform.js.

alex_tech: If you want, I can handle the js snippet change; I have a small script to regenerate snippets from openapi. Saves time.

maria_docs: Please do — that'd be great. I'll update the migration note + PR description. Marking reviewers: @alex_tech @jordan_api @sam_platform

jordan_api: :eyes: I'll check the server docs compatibility note and add a short comment in the PR about keeping alias for 2 releases.

maria_docs: :sparkles: PR updated with changes, waiting for CI. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321

docs-bot: CI: docs-lint passed on commit a1b2c3. Preview: https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/4321

sam_platform: :rocket: preview looks good, examples render correctly. Merging after approvals.

alex_tech: :white_check_mark: LGTM. Merging now.

docs-bot: PR merged by alex_tech — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321

maria_docs: :tada: thanks all — I'll follow up with a short migration note in the release notes.
